correctness.rationale: Exact conditional first-success probabilities are (u−1)/(u+v−2) and (v−1)/(u+v−2), leading to the all-parameter rational recurrence. Its difference equation and symmetry prove unique/tied balanced maxima. The feasibility-edge product and gamma limit follow directly. Summation gives the urn with replacement rows (2,1)/(1,2); the conditional moment recurrence proves the stated exact variance and weak Gaussian limit by all moments. The packaged standalone full labeled-state checker passed 514 comparisons including exact fractions. The proof does not mistake finite checks for infinite certification.

value.rationale: Perfect adsorption is a physical rare-event probability on a natural dense heterogeneous network. The full stoichiometric composition range is classified, revealing a sharp optimal design, exponentially small extreme-feasibility chance with a nontrivial one-sixth algebraic exponent, a linear single-site boundary sensitivity, and a square-root Gaussian composition window. The exact physical-to-urn correspondence links kinetic jamming and asymptotic design fluctuations. It is not an isolated table value, routine change of variables or unmotivated arbitrary slice.
